items.title: Wilson "Willie T" Turbinton Interview, 1990-09
items.q: one of the greatest experiences that I've had and the things that I've learned was from my experience of playing with George.

ctx.x: Do you, did you have anything to do with like the school concept of the workshop? I know that you all had plans to maybe bring in some kids and spend some time with them. Was that more Earl's interest or yours or everybody's?

Well, I think Earl is always gravitated towards sharing the experience of trying to inform people on another level. I mean, Earl would go and play in the prisons. I mean, stuff that a lot of people would shy off from. But you've got to understand that George Davis comes from a serious educational background. And one of the greatest experiences that I've had and the things that I've learned was from my experience of playing with George. I mean, George played with the Juilliard. I mean, he is a much greater…
Do you have any special, one night that stands out in your mind as very special from the workshop? What is it, Rene?
